verdict.rationale: Codex CLI lets you pass an error screenshot, architecture diagram, or design reference image with a prompt (or paste an image into the composer), which supports image-driven code generation, but there is no documented PDF input support and no first-party example of turning a sketch/design into a full working app end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit PDF-to-app support, a documented sketch/design-to-app workflow or case study, and independent confirmation that image-derived apps actually work as intended.
